scope: Saved-output automatic analysis; strict choices and value matches are proxies, not completed semantic or human validation.

definitions.primary_automatic: Strict concise target-choice proxy; numerical target production is reported separately.
definitions.semantic_endpoint: Required and pending actual human judgments; not inferred from proxy scores.
definitions.aggregation: Mean of the planned rounds within each question, then equal-weight mean across questions.
definitions.missingness: Missing, empty, malformed, truncated or non-normal generations are unknown; main rates/differences have planned-denominator bounds.
definitions.sensitivity: Complete-question and paired-complete-question estimates retain explicit reduced denominators.
definitions.round_range: Descriptive minimum/maximum across fresh rounds, not a confidence interval or independent-sample claim.
definitions.interval_policy: No population confidence interval or significance test is produced by this script.

execution.source_group_and_unit_limits: Questions and source titles are fixed. Rounds and condition reuse do not create new independent questions; the corpus is shared.
